label: r3c4
name: r1c1 + entropy 0.01
hypothesis: This is r1c1 (2 epochs, lr 1.5e-3, 242k samples) with the entropy coefficient doubled to 0.01. More samples plus sustained exploration may lift the weaker r1c1 seed (0.918) and guard against the 0.47 plateau seen with neighbouring recipes. Paired with candidate 1, it tests whether entropy helps under either recipe. It is supported if the mean is above 0.936 with the minimum seed at least 0.93. It is refuted if either seed falls below 0.9.
